verses.original: שְׁמַ֣ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הַיּוֹם֙ אַתָּ֨ה עֹבֵ֤ר הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן אֶת־ לָבֹא֙ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת גּוֹיִ֔ם גְּדֹלִ֥ים וַעֲצֻמִ֖ים מִמֶּ֑ךָּ גְּדֹלֹ֥ת עָרִ֛ים וּבְצֻרֹ֖ת בַּשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: šə·ma‘ yiś·rā·’êl hay·yō·wm ’at·tāh ‘ō·ḇêr hay·yar·dên ’eṯ- lā·ḇō lā·re·šeṯ gō·w·yim gə·ḏō·lîm wa·‘ă·ṣu·mîm mim·me·kā gə·ḏō·lōṯ ‘ā·rîm ū·ḇə·ṣu·rōṯ baš·šā·mā·yim
verses.literal: Hear O Israel Today you are about to cross the Jordan - to go in and dispossess nations greater and stronger than you with large cities fortified to the heavens

verses.original: עַֽם־ גָּד֥וֹל וָרָ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י עֲנָקִ֑ים אַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֙עְתָּ֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר וְאַתָּ֣ה שָׁמַ֔עְתָּ מִ֣י יִתְיַצֵּ֔ב לִפְנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י עֲנָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: ‘am- gā·ḏō·wl wā·rām bə·nê ‘ă·nā·qîm ’at·tāh yā·ḏa‘·tā ’ă·šer wə·’at·tāh šā·ma‘·tā mî yiṯ·yaṣ·ṣêḇ lip̄·nê bə·nê ‘ă·nāq
verses.literal: The people are strong and tall the descendants of the Anakim You know about them and you have heard it said Who can stand up to the sons of Anak

verses.original: וְיָדַעְתָּ֣ כִּי֩ הַיּ֗וֹם יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ הֽוּא־ הָעֹבֵ֤ר לְפָנֶ֙יךָ֙ אֹֽכְלָ֔ה ה֧וּא אֵ֣שׁ יַשְׁמִידֵ֛ם וְה֥וּא יַכְנִיעֵ֖ם לְפָנֶ֑יךָ וְהֽוֹרַשְׁתָּ֤ם וְהַֽאַבַדְתָּם֙ מַהֵ֔ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֶּ֥ר לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ḏa‘·tā kî hay·yō·wm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā hū- hā·‘ō·ḇêr lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā ’ō·ḵə·lāh hū ’êš yaš·mî·ḏêm wə·hū yaḵ·nî·‘êm lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā wə·hō·w·raš·tām wə·ha·ʾa·ḇaḏ·tå̄m ma·hêr ka·’ă·šer Yah·weh dib·ber lāḵ
verses.literal: But understand that today the LORD your God - goes across ahead of you as a consuming . . . fire He will destroy them . . . and subdue them before you And you will drive them out and annihilate them swiftly as the LORD has promised you

verses.original: יְהוָה֩ אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ אֹתָ֥ם׀ בַּהֲדֹ֣ף מִלְּפָנֶיךָ֮ לֵאמֹר֒ אַל־ תֹּאמַ֣ר בִּלְבָבְךָ֗ בְּצִדְקָתִי֙ יְהוָ֔ה הֱבִיאַ֣נִי לָרֶ֖שֶׁת אֶת־ הַזֹּ֑את הָאָ֣רֶץ יְהוָ֖ה וּבְרִשְׁעַת֙ הָאֵ֔לֶּה הַגּוֹיִ֣ם מִפָּנֶֽיךָ׃ מוֹרִישָׁ֥ם
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’ō·ṯām ba·hă·ḏōp̄ mil·lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā lê·mōr ’al- tō·mar bil·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā bə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯî Yah·weh hĕ·ḇî·’a·nî lā·re·šeṯ ’eṯ- haz·zōṯ hā·’ā·reṣ Yah·weh ū·ḇə·riš·‘aṯ hā·’êl·leh hag·gō·w·yim mip·pā·ne·ḵā mō·w·rî·šām
verses.literal: When the LORD your God - has driven them out before you . . . do not say in your heart Because of my righteousness the LORD has brought me in to possess - this land Rather, the LORD is driving out these nations before you because of their wickedness

verses.original: לֹ֣א בְצִדְקָתְךָ֗ וּבְיֹ֙שֶׁר֙ לְבָ֣בְךָ֔ אַתָּ֥ה בָ֖א לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אֶת־ אַרְצָ֑ם כִּ֞י בְּרִשְׁעַ֣ת׀ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ מוֹרִישָׁ֣ם הָאֵ֗לֶּה הַגּוֹיִ֣ם מִפָּנֶ֔יךָ וּלְמַ֜עַן הָקִ֣ים אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָה֙ נִשְׁבַּ֤ע לַאֲבֹתֶ֔יךָ לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם לְיִצְחָ֖ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: lō ḇə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯə·ḵā ū·ḇə·yō·šer lə·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā ’at·tāh ḇā lā·re·šeṯ ’eṯ- ’ar·ṣām kî bə·riš·‘aṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā mō·w·rî·šām hā·’êl·leh hag·gō·w·yim mip·pā·ne·ḵā ū·lə·ma·‘an hā·qîm ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer Yah·weh niš·ba‘ la·’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā lə·’aḇ·rā·hām lə·yiṣ·ḥāq ū·lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: It is not because of your righteousness or uprightness of heart that you are going in to possess their land but [it is] because of their wickedness that the LORD your God is driving out these nations before you to keep - the promise - He swore to your fathers to Abraham Isaac and Jacob

verses.original: וְיָדַעְתָּ֗ כִּ֠י לֹ֤א בְצִדְקָֽתְךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֠לֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵ֨ן לְךָ֜ אֶת־ הַזֹּ֖את הַטּוֹבָ֛ה הָאָ֧רֶץ לְרִשְׁתָּ֑הּ כִּ֥י אָֽתָּה׃ קְשֵׁה־ עֹ֖רֶף עַם־
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ḏa‘·tā kî lō ḇə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯə·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nō·ṯên lə·ḵā ’eṯ- haz·zōṯ haṭ·ṭō·w·ḇāh hā·’ā·reṣ lə·riš·tāh kî ’āt·tāh qə·šêh- ‘ō·rep̄ ‘am-
verses.literal: Understand, then that it is not because of your righteousness that the LORD your God is giving you - this good land to possess for you are a stiff-necked . . . people

verses.original: זְכֹר֙ אַל־ תִּשְׁכַּ֔ח אֵ֧ת אֲשֶׁר־ הִקְצַ֛פְתָּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר לְמִן־ הַיּ֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ יָצָ֣אתָ׀ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֗יִם עַד־ בֹּֽאֲכֶם֙ עַד־ הַזֶּ֔ה הַמָּק֣וֹם הֱיִיתֶ֖ם מַמְרִ֥ים עִם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: zə·ḵōr ’al- tiš·kaḥ ’êṯ ’ă·šer- hiq·ṣap̄·tā ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bam·miḏ·bār lə·min- hay·yō·wm ’ă·šer- yā·ṣā·ṯā mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim ‘aḏ- bō·’ă·ḵem ‘aḏ- haz·zeh ham·mā·qō·wm hĕ·yî·ṯem mam·rîm ‘im- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Remember this and never forget - how you provoked - the LORD your God in the wilderness From the day - you left the land of Egypt until you reached . . . this place you have been rebelling against the LORD

verses.original: וּבְחֹרֵ֥ב הִקְצַפְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה יְהוָ֛ה וַיִּתְאַנַּ֧ף בָּכֶ֖ם לְהַשְׁמִ֥יד אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·ḥō·rêḇ hiq·ṣap̄·tem ’eṯ- Yah·weh Yah·weh way·yiṯ·’an·nap̄ bā·ḵem lə·haš·mîḏ ’eṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: At Horeb you provoked - the LORD and He was angry enough to destroy you

verses.original: בַּעֲלֹתִ֣י הָהָ֗רָה לָקַ֜חַת לוּחֹ֤ת הָֽאֲבָנִים֙ לוּחֹ֣ת הַבְּרִ֔ית אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֖ה כָּרַ֥ת עִמָּכֶ֑ם וָאֵשֵׁ֣ב בָּהָ֗ר אַרְבָּעִ֥ים יוֹם֙ וְאַרְבָּעִ֣ים לַ֔יְלָה אָכַ֔לְתִּי לֹ֣א לֶ֚חֶם שָׁתִֽיתִי׃ לֹ֥א וּמַ֖יִם
verses.transliteration: ba·‘ă·lō·ṯî hā·hā·rāh lā·qa·ḥaṯ lū·ḥōṯ hā·’ă·ḇā·nîm lū·ḥōṯ hab·bə·rîṯ ’ă·šer- Yah·weh kā·raṯ ‘im·mā·ḵem wā·’ê·šêḇ bā·hār ’ar·bā·‘îm yō·wm wə·’ar·bā·‘îm lay·lāh ’ā·ḵal·tî lō le·ḥem šā·ṯî·ṯî lō ū·ma·yim
verses.literal: When I went up on the mountain to receive the tablets of stone the tablets of the covenant that the LORD made with you I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights I ate no bread and drank no water

verses.original: יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י אֶת־ וַיִּתֵּ֨ן שְׁנֵי֙ הָֽאֲבָנִ֔ים לוּחֹ֣ת כְּתֻבִ֖ים בְּאֶצְבַּ֣ע אֱלֹהִ֑ים כְּֽכָל־ הַדְּבָרִ֡ים וַעֲלֵיהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְהוָ֨ה דִּבֶּר֩ עִמָּכֶ֥ם מִתּ֥וֹךְ הָאֵ֖שׁ בָּהָ֛ר בְּי֥וֹם הַקָּהָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ê·lay ’eṯ- way·yit·tên šə·nê hā·’ă·ḇā·nîm lū·ḥōṯ kə·ṯu·ḇîm bə·’eṣ·ba‘ ’ĕ·lō·hîm kə·ḵāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm wa·‘ă·lê·hem ’ă·šer Yah·weh dib·ber ‘im·mā·ḵem mit·tō·wḵ hā·’êš bā·hār bə·yō·wm haq·qā·hāl
verses.literal: Then the LORD . . . - gave me the two stone tablets inscribed by the finger of God with the exact words - that the LORD spoke to you out of the fire on the mountain on the day of the assembly

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י מִקֵּץ֙ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם וְאַרְבָּעִ֖ים לָ֑יְלָה יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י אֶת־ נָתַ֨ן שְׁנֵ֛י הָאֲבָנִ֖ים לֻחֹ֥ת לֻח֥וֹת הַבְּרִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî miq·qêṣ ’ar·bā·‘îm yō·wm wə·’ar·bā·‘îm lā·yə·lāh Yah·weh ’ê·lay ’eṯ- nā·ṯan šə·nê hā·’ă·ḇā·nîm lu·ḥōṯ lu·ḥō·wṯ hab·bə·rîṯ
verses.literal: And at the end of forty days and forty nights the LORD . . . - gave me the two stone tablets the tablets of the covenant

verses.original: יְהוָ֜ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלַ֗י ק֣וּם רֵ֤ד מִזֶּ֔ה מַהֵר֙ כִּ֚י עַמְּךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוֹצֵ֖אתָ מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם שִׁחֵ֣ת מַהֵ֗ר סָ֣רוּ מִן־ הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֔ם עָשׂ֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם מַסֵּכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’ê·lay qūm rêḏ miz·zeh ma·hêr kî ‘am·mə·ḵā ’ă·šer hō·w·ṣê·ṯā mim·miṣ·rā·yim ši·ḥêṯ ma·hêr sā·rū min- had·de·reḵ ’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯim ‘ā·śū lā·hem mas·sê·ḵāh
verses.literal: And the LORD said to me Get up and go down from here at once for your people whom you brought out of Egypt have corrupted [themselves] How quickly they have turned aside from the way that I commanded them They have made for themselves a molten image

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלַ֣י לֵאמֹ֑ר רָאִ֙יתִי֙ אֶת־ הַזֶּ֔ה הָעָ֣ם הֽוּא׃ וְהִנֵּ֥ה קְשֵׁה־ עֹ֖רֶף עַם־
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’ê·lay lê·mōr rā·’î·ṯî ’eṯ- haz·zeh hā·‘ām hū wə·hin·nêh qə·šêh- ‘ō·rep̄ ‘am-
verses.literal: The LORD also said to me . . . I have seen - this people and they are indeed a stiff-necked . . . people

verses.original: הֶ֤רֶף וְאַשְׁמִידֵ֔ם וְאֶמְחֶ֣ה אֶת־ שְׁמָ֔ם מִמֶּ֙נִּי֙ מִתַּ֖חַת הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְאֶֽעֱשֶׂה֙ אֽוֹתְךָ֔ לְגוֹי־ עָצ֥וּם וָרָ֖ב מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: he·rep̄ wə·’aš·mî·ḏêm wə·’em·ḥeh ’eṯ- šə·mām mim·men·nî mit·ta·ḥaṯ haš·šā·mā·yim wə·’e·‘ĕ·śeh ’ō·wṯ·ḵā lə·ḡō·w- ‘ā·ṣūm wā·rāḇ mim·men·nū
verses.literal: Leave Me alone so that I may destroy them and blot out - their name from under heaven Then I will make - you into a nation mightier and greater than they [are]

verses.original: וָאֵ֗פֶן וָֽאֵרֵד֙ מִן־ הָהָ֔ר וְהָהָ֖ר בֹּעֵ֣ר בָּאֵ֑שׁ וּשְׁנֵי֙ לֻחֹ֣ת הַבְּרִ֔ית עַ֖ל שְׁתֵּ֥י יָדָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ê·p̄en wā·’ê·rêḏ min- hā·hār wə·hā·hār bō·‘êr bā·’êš ū·šə·nê lu·ḥōṯ hab·bə·rîṯ ‘al šə·tê yā·ḏāy
verses.literal: So I went back down . . . the mountain while it was blazing with fire with the two tablets of the covenant in . . . my hands

verses.original: וָאֵ֗רֶא וְהִנֵּ֤ה חֲטָאתֶם֙ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם עֲשִׂיתֶ֣ם לָכֶ֔ם מַסֵּכָ֑ה עֵ֖גֶל סַרְתֶּ֣ם מַהֵ֔ר מִן־ הַדֶּ֕רֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֶתְכֶֽם׃ צִוָּ֥ה
verses.transliteration: wā·’ê·re wə·hin·nêh ḥă·ṭā·ṯem Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem ‘ă·śî·ṯem lā·ḵem mas·sê·ḵāh ‘ê·ḡel sar·tem ma·hêr min- had·de·reḵ ’ă·šer- Yah·weh ’eṯ·ḵem ṣiw·wāh
verses.literal: And I saw how you had sinned against the LORD your God you had made for yourselves a molten calf You had turned aside quickly from the way that the LORD - had commanded you

verses.original: וָאֶתְפֹּשׂ֙ בִּשְׁנֵ֣י הַלֻּחֹ֔ת וָֽאַשְׁלִכֵ֔ם מֵעַ֖ל שְׁתֵּ֣י יָדָ֑י וָאֲשַׁבְּרֵ֖ם לְעֵינֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eṯ·pōś biš·nê hal·lu·ḥōṯ wā·’aš·li·ḵêm mê·‘al šə·tê yā·ḏāy wā·’ă·šab·bə·rêm lə·‘ê·nê·ḵem
verses.literal: So I took the two tablets and threw them out of . . . my hands shattering them before your eyes

verses.original: וָֽאֶתְנַפַּל֩ לִפְנֵ֨י יְהוָ֜ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים יוֹם֙ וְאַרְבָּעִ֣ים לַ֔יְלָה כָּרִאשֹׁנָ֗ה לֹ֣א אָכַ֔לְתִּי לֶ֚חֶם שָׁתִ֑יתִי וּמַ֖יִם לֹ֣א עַ֤ל כָּל־ חַטַּאתְכֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חֲטָאתֶ֔ם לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הָרַ֛ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לְהַכְעִיסֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eṯ·nap·pal lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’ar·bā·‘îm yō·wm wə·’ar·bā·‘îm lay·lāh kā·ri·šō·nāh lō ’ā·ḵal·tî le·ḥem šā·ṯî·ṯî ū·ma·yim lō ‘al kāl- ḥaṭ·ṭaṯ·ḵem ’ă·šer ḥă·ṭā·ṯem la·‘ă·śō·wṯ hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh lə·haḵ·‘î·sōw
verses.literal: Then I fell down before the LORD for forty days and forty nights as [I had done] the first time I did not eat bread or drink water . . . because of all the sin - you had committed in doing what was evil in the sight of the LORD and provoking Him to anger

verses.original: כִּ֣י יָגֹ֗רְתִּי מִפְּנֵ֤י הָאַף֙ וְהַ֣חֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֛ה קָצַ֧ף עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם לְהַשְׁמִ֣יד אֶתְכֶ֑ם יְהוָה֙ וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע אֵלַ֔י הַהִֽוא׃ בַּפַּ֥עַם גַּ֖ם
verses.transliteration: kî yā·ḡō·rə·tî mip·pə·nê hā·’ap̄ wə·ha·ḥê·māh ’ă·šer Yah·weh qā·ṣap̄ ‘ă·lê·ḵem lə·haš·mîḏ ’eṯ·ḵem Yah·weh way·yiš·ma‘ ’ê·lay ha·hi·w bap·pa·‘am gam
verses.literal: For I was afraid . . . of the anger and wrath that the LORD had directed against you enough to destroy you - But the LORD listened to me this time as well

verses.original: יְהוָ֛ה הִתְאַנַּ֧ף מְאֹ֖ד וּֽבְאַהֲרֹ֗ן לְהַשְׁמִיד֑וֹ הַהִֽוא בָּעֵ֥ת גַּם־ וָֽאֶתְפַּלֵּ֛ל בְּעַ֥ד אַהֲרֹ֖ן
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh hiṯ·’an·nap̄ mə·’ōḏ ū·ḇə·’a·hă·rōn lə·haš·mî·ḏōw ha·hi·w bā·‘êṯ gam- wā·’eṯ·pal·lêl bə·‘aḏ ’a·hă·rōn
verses.literal: The LORD was angry enough with Aaron to destroy him but at that time I also prayed for Aaron

verses.original: וְֽאֶת־ לָקַחְתִּי֮ אֲשֶׁר־ חַטַּאתְכֶ֞ם הָעֵ֗גֶל עֲשִׂיתֶ֣ם אֶת־ וָאֶשְׂרֹ֣ף אֹת֣וֹ׀ בָּאֵשׁ֒ וָאֶכֹּ֨ת אֹת֤וֹ טָחוֹן֙ הֵיטֵ֔ב עַ֥ד אֲשֶׁר־ דַּ֖ק לְעָפָ֑ר וָֽאַשְׁלִךְ֙ אֶת־ עֲפָר֔וֹ אֶל־ הַנַּ֖חַל הַיֹּרֵ֥ד מִן־ הָהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- lā·qaḥ·tî ’ă·šer- ḥaṭ·ṭaṯ·ḵem hā·‘ê·ḡel ‘ă·śî·ṯem ’eṯ- wā·’eś·rōp̄ ’ō·ṯōw bā·’êš wā·’ek·kōṯ ’ō·ṯōw ṭā·ḥō·wn hê·ṭêḇ ‘aḏ ’ă·šer- daq lə·‘ā·p̄ār wā·’aš·liḵ ’eṯ- ‘ă·p̄ā·rōw ’el- han·na·ḥal hay·yō·rêḏ min- hā·hār
verses.literal: And I took that sinful thing the calf you had made - and burned it in the fire Then I crushed it - [and] ground it to - powder as fine as dust and I cast - it into the stream that came down from the mountain

verses.original: מַקְצִפִ֥ים הֱיִיתֶ֖ם אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃ וּבְתַבְעֵרָה֙ וּבְמַסָּ֔ה וּבְקִבְרֹ֖ת הַֽתַּאֲוָ֑ה
verses.transliteration: maq·ṣi·p̄îm hĕ·yî·ṯem ’eṯ- Yah·weh ū·ḇə·ṯaḇ·‘ê·rāh ū·ḇə·mas·sāh ū·ḇə·qiḇ·rōṯ hat·ta·’ă·wāh
verses.literal: You continued to provoke . . . - the LORD at Taberah at Massah vvv and at Kibroth-hattaavah

verses.original: יְהוָ֜ה אֶתְכֶ֗ם וּבִשְׁלֹ֨חַ מִקָּדֵ֤שׁ בַּרְנֵ֙עַ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר עֲלוּ֙ וּרְשׁ֣וּ אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לָכֶ֑ם וַתַּמְר֗וּ אֶת־ פִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם וְלֹ֤א הֶֽאֱמַנְתֶּם֙ ל֔וֹ וְלֹ֥א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֖ם בְּקֹלֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’eṯ·ḵem ū·ḇiš·lō·aḥ miq·qā·ḏêš bar·nê·a‘ lê·mōr ‘ă·lū ū·rə·šū ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tî lā·ḵem wat·tam·rū ’eṯ- pî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem wə·lō he·’ĕ·man·tem lōw wə·lō šə·ma‘·tem bə·qō·lōw
verses.literal: And when the LORD - sent you out . . . from Kadesh-barnea He said Go up and possess - the land that I have given you But you rebelled - against the command of the LORD your God You neither believed Him nor obeyed Him

verses.original: הֱיִיתֶ֖ם מַמְרִ֥ים עִם־ יְהוָ֑ה מִיּ֖וֹם דַּעְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hĕ·yî·ṯem mam·rîm ‘im- Yah·weh mî·yō·wm da‘·tî ’eṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: You have been rebelling against the LORD since the day I came to know you -

verses.original: וָֽאֶתְנַפַּ֞ל לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֵ֣ת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים הַיּ֛וֹם וְאֶת־ אַרְבָּעִ֥ים הַלַּ֖יְלָה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִתְנַפָּ֑לְתִּי כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֖ה אָמַ֥ר לְהַשְׁמִ֥יד אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eṯ·nap·pal lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’êṯ ’ar·bā·‘îm hay·yō·wm wə·’eṯ- ’ar·bā·‘îm hal·lay·lāh ’ă·šer hiṯ·nap·pā·lə·tî kî- Yah·weh ’ā·mar lə·haš·mîḏ ’eṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: So I fell down before the LORD - for forty days and forty nights - - because the LORD had said He would destroy you

verses.original: וָאֶתְפַּלֵּ֣ל אֶל־ יְהוָה֮ וָאֹמַר֒ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה אַל־ תַּשְׁחֵ֤ת עַמְּךָ֙ וְנַחֲלָ֣תְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּדִ֖יתָ בְּגָדְלֶ֑ךָ אֲשֶׁר־ הוֹצֵ֥אתָ מִמִּצְרַ֖יִם חֲזָקָֽה׃ בְּיָ֥ד
verses.transliteration: wā·’eṯ·pal·lêl ’el- Yah·weh wā·’ō·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’al- taš·ḥêṯ ‘am·mə·ḵā wə·na·ḥă·lā·ṯə·ḵā ’ă·šer pā·ḏî·ṯā bə·ḡā·ḏə·le·ḵā ’ă·šer- hō·w·ṣê·ṯā mim·miṣ·ra·yim ḥă·zā·qāh bə·yāḏ
verses.literal: And I prayed to the LORD and said O Lord GOD do not destroy Your people Your inheritance whom You redeemed through Your greatness - and brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand

verses.original: זְכֹר֙ לַעֲבָדֶ֔יךָ לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם לְיִצְחָ֖ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹ֑ב אַל־ תֵּ֗פֶן אֶל־ קְשִׁי֙ הַזֶּ֔ה וְאֶל־ הָעָ֣ם רִשְׁע֖וֹ וְאֶל־ חַטָּאתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: zə·ḵōr la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā lə·’aḇ·rā·hām lə·yiṣ·ḥāq ū·lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’al- tê·p̄en ’el- qə·šî haz·zeh wə·’el- hā·‘ām riš·‘ōw wə·’el- ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Remember Your servants Abraham Isaac and Jacob Overlook . . . . . . the stubbornness of this . . . people and the wickedness . . . of their sin

verses.original: פֶּן־ הָאָרֶץ֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הוֹצֵאתָ֣נוּ מִשָּׁם֒ יֹאמְר֗וּ יְהוָ֔ה מִבְּלִי֙ יְכֹ֣לֶת לַהֲבִיאָ֕ם אֶל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם וּמִשִּׂנְאָת֣וֹ אוֹתָ֔ם הוֹצִיאָ֖ם לַהֲמִתָ֥ם בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: pen- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer hō·w·ṣê·ṯā·nū miš·šām yō·mə·rū Yah·weh mib·bə·lî yə·ḵō·leṯ la·hă·ḇî·’ām ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- dib·ber lā·hem ū·miś·śin·’ā·ṯōw ’ō·w·ṯām hō·w·ṣî·’ām la·hă·mi·ṯām bam·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: Otherwise those in the land from which You brought us out . . . will say Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land - He had promised them and because He hated them He has brought them out to kill them in the wilderness

verses.original: וְהֵ֥ם עַמְּךָ֖ וְנַחֲלָתֶ֑ךָ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הוֹצֵ֙אתָ֙ הַגָּדֹ֔ל בְּכֹחֲךָ֣ הַנְּטוּיָֽה׃פ וּבִֽזְרֹעֲךָ֖
verses.transliteration: wə·hêm ‘am·mə·ḵā wə·na·ḥă·lā·ṯe·ḵā ’ă·šer hō·w·ṣê·ṯā hag·gā·ḏōl bə·ḵō·ḥă·ḵā han·nə·ṭū·yāh ū·ḇiz·rō·‘ă·ḵā
verses.literal: But they are Your people Your inheritance whom You brought out by Your great power and outstretched arm
